summary: The audit checks the 60 units, at least 36 in Linguistics: LINGUIST 196, a core course in each of three areas, breadth courses in two of four areas, two depth courses of 3-4 units, the WIM (LINGUIST 120A) and the capstone (LINGUIST 197A), all letter graded with a C- or better, plus further LINGUIST courses for the remaining units. At most 12 units below the 100 level and 8 CR/NC units count, and language courses do not count. Honors adds LINGUIST 199 and 198 (10 units) and 70 units in all. Checked by hand: courses from other departments (they need the Director of Undergraduate Studies' approval), that your additional courses form a coherent program, no more than three CR/NC courses, the language requirement, and the honors thesis.

totals.label: Language courses
totals.why: Language Requirement: "Language courses do not count toward the 60 required units for the major."

totals.label: 36 units in Linguistics
totals.why: Policies: "A minimum of 60 units of course work; at least 36 of these units must be in Linguistics."

totals.label: Units below the 100 level
totals.why: Grading: "Of the 60 units required for the major, no more than 12 may be below the 100-level"

totals.label: CR/NC units
totals.why: Grading: "a maximum of 3 courses, totaling no more than 8 units, may be taken on a credit/no credit basis (CR/NC)." The three-course part is checked by hand.

totals.label: 70 units with honors
totals.why: Honors: "Honors students complete 70 units, including the 60 units for the major, plus ten additional units of Honors Research."

KpLRz8CF.why: Depth notes: "Must be taken for 3-4 units each" Grading: "All required courses must be taken for a letter grade of C- or better."

vNay7mMQ.why: "The remaining units may be in linguistics or related fields and should form a coherent program of study ... get specific approval from the Linguistics Director of Undergraduate Studies for courses outside the department." Linguistics courses count toward the 60 units on their own; a course from another department is moved in once approved. The 60 units ("the 60 required units for the major") are the program's minimum. Other requirements: "Additional courses counting toward the 60 unit requirement should form a coherent program of study, and specific courses must be approved by the Director of Undergraduate Studies."
